name: dev-spec-driven
description: Unified, track-based spec-driven development: EARS requirements, technical design, traceable tasks, and approval-gated execution. Composes optional TDD, SaaS-scale, and AI-eval tracks per feature. Ships a fully local, zero-dependency MCP server for spec scaffolding, classification, EARS linting, traceability, evidence-gated task tracking, change impact, metrics, a living spec catalog, drift checks, and import from Kiro / spec-kit / OpenSpec. No cloud, no CI, no cost.
